info.title: Miz Ban API
info.description: Two-sided 360-degree visual table-reservation platform - API v1.

get.description:
Readiness probe (Task T-004): bounded DB and Redis checks.

Never exposes credentials, connection strings or internals.
List all venues belonging to the authenticated owner.

post.description: Create a new venue for the authenticated owner (is_approved=False).

get.description: Get owner's venue detail. Enforces IDOR check.

put.description: Update owner's venue. Enforces IDOR check and invalidates cache on commit.

post.description: Approve a venue and invalidate its public cache.
Reject/unapprove a venue and invalidate its public cache.

get.description:
List approved venues with active subscription (BR-005).

Privacy: Never exposes owner phone number or internal status flags.

Public detail for an approved venue with active subscription.

Cached with 3600s TTL (ARCH-004). Returns 404 for unapproved venues.

post.description:
Create a new space for an owned venue (Task T-018b).

Guarantees:
- Authenticated venue owners only (and only for venues they own).
- Rejects client-spoofed venue id.
- Rejects extra fields and validates name non-empty and display_order >= 0.

get.summary: List spaces for a venue (Owner or Public)
get.description:
List spaces for a venue (Task T-018b).

Dual behavior:
1. If identifier is an integer venue_id:
   - Requires authenticated venue owner/admin (401 unauthenticated, 403 foreign).
   - Returns all spaces (active and inactive) for that venue.
2. If identifier is a slug:
   - Public endpoint gated by BR-005.
   - Returns active spaces only for approved venues with active subscription.
   - Otherwise returns 404 with zero info leak.

post.description:
Upload a raw 360-degree panorama image for a space (Task T-016).

Guarantees:
- Authenticated venue owners only (and only for venues they own).
- Enforces 20 MB size limit.
- Validates magic bytes and verifies image with Pillow.
- Stores file with generated UUID under media/panoramas/{venue_id}/{uuid}.<ext>.
- Creates PanoramaImage in UPLOADED status.
- Dispatches processing via transaction.on_commit seam.
- Returns HTTP 202 Accepted.

post.summary: Create and place a table pin in a space (Owner)
post.description:
Create and place a table pin within a space (Task T-018).

- Only accessible by venue owner (or admin).
- pitch bounds: [-90.0, 90.0]
- yaw bounds: [-180.0, 180.0]
- capacity > 0
- Venue derived server-side from space.venue.

get.summary: List all table pins in a space (Owner)
get.description: List all table pins in a space for the venue owner.
Retrieve details for a single table pin.

put.description: Update coordinates, table number, capacity, or status of a table pin.

patch.description: Partial update of table pin fields.

delete.description:
Delete a table pin (Task T-018).

Guarded by T-015 / ADR-005 PROTECT rule:
Pins with existing bookings cannot be deleted (returns 409 TABLE_PIN_PROTECTED).
Pins without bookings are deleted cleanly (returns 204).

post.description: Soft-deactivate a table pin so it cannot be booked (ADR-005).

get.summary: Get public 360 panorama and active pins for a space
get.description:
Public panorama scene and active pins (Task T-018 / BR-005).

Returns 200 with WebP image URL and active pins if:
- Venue is approved and subscription is ACTIVE
- Space is active
- A READY panorama image exists
Otherwise returns 404 with zero info leak.

get.summary: Get public 360 panorama and active pins for a space (direct /spaces route)
Get space detail (Dual-purpose: Owner or Public under BR-005)
get.description:
Retrieve space detail (Task T-018b).

- Owner/Admin: returns the space regardless of active status or BR-005.
- Public: returns the space ONLY IF venue satisfies BR-005 and space is active.
  Otherwise returns 404 with zero info leak.

patch.description: Partial update of space fields (Task T-018b).

put.description: Full/partial update of space fields (Task T-018b).

delete.description:
Delete or deactivate a space following T-015 / ADR-005 policy (Task T-018b).

- If pins with bookings exist -> 409 TABLE_PIN_PROTECTED (space remains).
- If pins or panoramas exist (no bookings) -> deactivates space, returns 200 with SpaceOut (space remains).
- If no pins and no panoramas -> hard-deletes space, returns 204 No Content.

schema.title: Table Pin Id

parameters.description: Optional table pin ID to filter available slots for that table

get.description:
Retrieve 90-minute slots for a venue on the requested date.

Slot availability is computed dynamically (BR-001 / BR-002) and is NEVER cached (ARCH-004).
If table_pin_id is provided, filters available slots using the T-011 availability filter.

post.description:
Initiate a 10-minute temporary booking lock on a table pin and slot (TD-004).

Views stay thin (ARCH-001): authenticate, validate via schemas,
delegate to services.py, map domain errors.
